answer: Latency-Cadence Enrollment. Each identity must submit a stream of proofs whose inter-arrival gaps match a measured human cadence; agents reviewing enrollment reject bursts that skip the normal warm-up canyon between first contact and full access. A new identity waits in a haven of reduced throughput until its gap distribution stabilizes. Callers crossing a dune of near-identical timestamps trigger throttling, so the attacker must rent or idle real wall-clock time per clone—hours of staggered pacing—before any clone reaches full traffic weight.
